en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I asked about what comes out from the sea, from the pearls and the sapphire and the aquamarine, and from the mines, the gold and the silver, what (is due) regarding it?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When its prices reaches a Dinar, so regarding it is the Khums (fifth)’.
